draft.title: Using congruence in proofs
card: Two triangles are congruent when they match exactly. Prove it with a test: SSS, SAS, ASA, AAS or RHS. Give the test as the reason.
Once the triangles are congruent, all their matching sides and angles are equal. Write the reason as: corresponding sides (or angles) in congruent triangles.
Use this to prove a fact about a shape. Pick two triangles that share the parts you need, prove them congruent, then state the equal sides or angles you want.

In a parallelogram \(ABCD\), the diagonal \(AC\) splits it into \(\triangle ABC\) and \(\triangle CDA\). \(AB = CD\) and \(BC = DA\) (opposite sides), and \(AC\) is common. So the triangles are congruent (SSS), and \(\angle B = \angle D\) (corresponding angles in congruent triangles).
draft.remember: Prove the triangles congruent first, then use their matching parts to prove the fact you want.

a.q: In a proof, triangles \(PQR\) and \(XYZ\) are shown to be congruent. Which reason then proves \(\angle Q = \angle Y\)?
opts: Angles in a triangle add to \(180^{\circ}\)
Alternate angles on parallel lines are equal
a.why: Once the triangles are congruent, their matching angles are equal, and that is the reason to give. The angle sum reason is tempting, but it does not compare angles in two different triangles.
a.clue: What does congruence tell you about matching parts?

b.q: In a kite \(ABCD\), \(AB = AD\) and \(CB = CD\). Diagonal \(AC\) is drawn. Which test proves \(\triangle ABC\) and \(\triangle ADC\) congruent, so that \(\angle B = \angle D\)?
b.why: The triangles have \(AB = AD\), \(CB = CD\) and the shared side \(AC\): three pairs of equal sides, so SSS. SAS is tempting because of the shared side, but no equal angle is given, so it cannot be used.
b.clue: Count the pairs of equal sides, and check whether any angle is given.

wants.brief: Parallelogram ABCD with diagonal AC drawn. Mark AB and CD with one tick, BC and DA with two ticks, and label the triangles ABC and CDA.
wants.why: It shows which two triangles are used and which sides are equal.
